9,721 likes, 138 comments - htcityshowstoppers on October 20, 2026: "Dia Mirza (@diamirzaofficial) is a voice for compassion, conscious living, and meaningful change. With her quiet strength and unwavering commitment to causes close to her heart, she reminds us that the smallest everyday choices can make a difference.

For the shoot, she wears an ivory satin tissue pheran and matching pants set by House of DSAK (@houseofdsak), detailed with intricate Kashmiri Aari Tilla embroidery and finished with bold statement earrings from Manubhai Jewellers (@manubhaijewels).

Creative Direction: Shara Ashraf Prayag Mishra (@sharaashraf)
Styling: Theia Tekchandaney (@theiatekchandaney)

Prachi Sapra (@_prachisapra_)
On-set Support Team: Ayushi Mishra (@styledbyayushi), Sameera Shaikh (@sam_wearable_art)
Home Decor & Soft Furnishings: House of the Designery (@house_of_the_designery)
Plant Partner: Plant People (@plantpeople.in)
Location: Prestige Nautilus, Mumbai (@prestigeconstructions)
Artist Reputation Management: Communiqué Film PR (@communiquefilmpr)

#dia #diamirza #diamirzafans #cover #covershoot".
